status: proposal (claude-a/progression, 25 Oct); every number is a placeholder until play-tests and Claude L's harness
name: Velvet
identity: coastal duellist from Driftwood; one sabre in the LEFT hand (closed brass knuckle-bow), its empty scabbard on the RIGHT hip, one black lantern by its bail in the RIGHT hand
home_region_note: Claude K's proposal on #149 (25 Oct), not yet decided by Matt; it only sets the tier material

abilities.kit: game/data/abilities/velvet.json (Codex, #261); base and powered form unchanged

techniques.name: Riposte
techniques.binding: a parry in the first 0.2 s of a melee hit
techniques.effect: The next sabre cut comes faster. In the base form only; Black Lantern's long counter-thrust is unchanged.

upgrade.name: Riposte II
upgrade.effect: The riposte cut exposes the foe, as Lantern flare does.

techniques.name: Dim
techniques.effect: The lantern shutters after the flare; for a moment shooters lose track of her and hold fire.

upgrade.name: Dim II
upgrade.effect: A perfect dodge while dimmed takes time off the flare's cooldown.

techniques.name: Moth's Waltz
techniques.binding: the third sabre cut in a row
techniques.effect: The third cut becomes a stepping lunge-cut through the foe.

upgrade.name: Moth's Waltz II
upgrade.effect: The lunge leaves a pale echo that cuts once more half a second later.
